text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-huuuh?! W-wait, you're the one who
won, not
me, so I can't—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! I'll remember this
forever!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-all right! Now we just have to see how
much
confidence rubs off on me...
